gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zalando-sans: Expressive and wide-spaced, Bruno Ace SC strings its letters out like beads, with every stroke cut to a uniform width. Zalando Sans keeps paragraphs approachable, its curves left open and low in contrast.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-n: Spread-out letters, expressive and distinctive, lead the way. Bruno Ace SC supplies the beaded spacing, and Zen Kaku Gothic New settles underneath with open sans curves, no hairlines, no swells.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-zilla-slab: Zilla Slab reads sturdy and technical, with broad openings on its curves, set against a display heading of measured, uniform strokes. Bruno Ace SC stretches out wide while the slab stays grounded.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-clash-grotesk: Horseshoe-wide curves, diagonals as weighty as the uprights, plenty of swagger. Clash Grotesk, plain sans through and through, has no stroke modulation at all, which echoes the heading's weighty diagonals.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk has a lofty lowercase and bowls left open on one side, set beside Cherry Swash's commanding display shapes. Familjen Grotesk keeps long text lively without ever feeling busy.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-nunito: Commanding horseshoe curves, flat and unshaded. Nunito, plain sans with big round bowls and terminals that stop well short of the stem, softens Cherry Swash's firmness.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-quicksand: A horseshoe-wide c gives Cherry Swash its commanding look, while Quicksand brings tall, bulb-like bowls in plain sans lines. Quicksand keeps its bars uniform, so paragraphs flow smoothly and approachably.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-akatab: Round letters that look cupped rather than clenched give Cherry Swash's constant, unshaded strokes a friendly plain sans partner. Akatab keeps each paragraph approachable and unfussy from start to finish.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-alan-sans: Cherry Swash goes flat and contrast-free, its horseshoe-wide c and heavy diagonals commanding attention before Alan Sans arrives. Alan Sans reads smoothly, its curve tails held well back from the body.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans holds its apertures open at tiny sizes, with strokes that never change thickness by direction. And Cherry Swash supplies the commanding, horseshoe-wide swagger in the heading, giving the text something to follow.
